description: Fetch historical annual observations and units for specific real FRED series IDs. Returns raw retrieved data only — it does not generate any explanation or analysis. Use search_economic_series first to find real series IDs, then interpret the returned observations yourself to answer the user's question.

series.description: FRED series to fetch, typically the output of search_economic_series.

seriesId.description: A real FRED series ID, e.g. "CPIAUCSL".

name: get_series_observations
title: Get series observations
